meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: Claude 能读取、创建、写入 .h5ad 等格式的带注释矩阵数据,管理其中的观测、变量元数据,并支持子集、拼接、压缩存储等操作,用于单细胞等生物数据分析。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 .h5ad 文件、单细胞 RNA-seq 数据,或与 scanpy 等 scverse 生态工具整合时。

say.text: 读取这个 data.h5ad,显示 obs 里有哪些列。
say.note: 返回观测元数据的列名列表。

say.text: 把 batch1.h5ad 和 batch2.h5ad 拼接,加上批次标签。
say.note: 按观测轴合并,key='batch' 标注来源。

say.text: 将 processed.h5ad 用 gzip 压缩后写出。
say.note: 生成压缩的 h5ad 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can read, create, and write annotated matrix data in formats like .h5ad, manage observation/variable metadata, and perform subsetting, concatenation, and compressed storage for single-cell and other biological data analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work with .h5ad files, single-cell RNA-seq data, or integrate with scverse tools such as scanpy.

say_en.text: Read this data.h5ad and show the columns in obs.
say_en.note: Returns the list of observation metadata columns.

say_en.text: Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad with batch labels.
